archetypes.name: collector-gating
archetypes.rationale: Collector status now gates downstream ingestion across Bash and embedded assets.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the collector status flow end to end. Check that NOT_SUBSTANTIVE records remain terminal, are counted as failures, and cannot be reintroduced through raw output parsing, paths files, or embedded plan-review assets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: voter-compat
archetypes.rationale: parse-rate-retry remains as a compatibility wrapper while launch retry behavior was removed.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on parse-rate retry compatibility. Verify new dispatch-shaped argv works, legacy retry-only flags are harmless no-ops, and no retry prompt or first-pass artifacts are produced. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
